title: tjvz model config (the `model:` block of config.yaml)
description: There is ONE model: score = bias + sum(weight_i * feature_i(item)). No plugin registry - the variation that matters is all here. `scoring` is the forward model (features, weights, bias); `learning` (optional - omit to never run a learn) is how weights are learned from the event log. There is no normalisation layer, so a weight accounts for its feature's natural scale.

features.description: Active features. A registered feature omitted here is left out of the model entirely (still computed and cached for future models). Key = feature id.

weight.description: prior coefficient in the linear combine. Required for a scalar feature; omitted for a column-group feature (manifest expands:true), whose per-column weights are learned with prior 0 and outer weight fixed at 1.

params.description: override the feature manifest's default structural knobs

pinned.description: true -> never learned away from this weight (lambda -> inf on the coordinate). Default false.

readers.description: column-group feature only (reader_recs): hand-set prior weight / pin per reader source. Learned per-reader weights live in model.json; these are the priors a learn run shrinks toward (default 0, unpinned). Readers with no entry here (incl. AI sources) still get a learned weight with prior 0.

bias.description: additive constant. Does not affect ranking order; matters only when the score is read as a probability.

stochastic.description: true -> score() may return a per-pass sample (a future Thompson-style variant that keeps a weight posterior). Default false.

learning.description: Omit the whole block to never run a learn; the scoring weights are used as given.

utility.description: log_odds: learn predicts read; score is a log-odds. ev: learn predicts the rating; score is an expected rating.

positive.description: which decisions count as a positive label. Untouched items are unlabeled and excluded.

trainable.description: exactly one per learn run (identifiability). weights: all non-pinned weights. feature_params: all params a manifest marks tunable.

lambda0.description: base shrinkage strength toward the scoring weights (not toward 0)

anneal_n0.description: lambda = lambda0 * n0 / (n0 + n_events); removes the cold-start cliff

adopt.description: Gates a learned fit must clear before `tjvz model learn --adopt` replaces the scoring weights.
